title: First amplitude correct
description: Essential: Student identifies the amplitude of the first oscillation as the initial compression distance x.

title: Second amplitude correct
description: Essential: Student identifies the amplitude of the second oscillation as the initial compression distance 2x.

title: Ratio calculation
description: Important: Student correctly calculates the ratio A1/A2 as x/(2x) = 1/2.

title: Amplitude definition
description: Important: Student demonstrates understanding that amplitude is the maximum displacement from equilibrium, given by the initial displacement in this scenario.

title: Pitfall: Ratio inversion
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly inverts the ratio, giving A2/A1 = 2 as the final answer.

title: Pitfall: Misinterpreting 'oscillation'
description: Pitfall: Student confuses the order of oscillations or misinterprets 'for the first/second time' as referring to something other than the initial condition.
